AaveV4SpokesMeta.$comment: Meta-adapter (ADR 0010): one immutable adapter serving every Aave V4 Spoke. Constructor takes only the NAV proxy, so its CREATE2 address is fleet-wide (DeploySalts.AAVE_V4_SPOKES_META = 1 - version 1 is this adapter's FIRST generation; it was never plain-CREATE deployed). The active Spoke set lives on NAVCalculator (addMetaInstances/removeMetaInstances, from `instances` below - each entry is a Spoke address). Reserves are NOT instances: they are enumerated on-chain per Spoke by numeric id via getReserveCount()/getReserve(id). positionId = the Spoke, which is also the unit a v4 health factor is scoped to.
AaveV4SpokesMeta.$instanceComment_GoldSpoke: 0x65407b940966954b23dfA3caA5C0702bB42984DC = the Aave V4 Gold Spoke on Ethereum (SPOKE_REVISION() == 1, getReserveCount() == 8, reserve 0 = XAUt 0x68749665FF8D2d112Fa859AA293F07A622782F38 and is the Spoke's only collateral-only reserve, so positionLabels renders ["Spoke", "XAUt"]). Verified on-chain 2026-09-10; this is the Spoke already carried in the live NAV's meta-instance set for this adapter.
AaveV4SpokesMeta.$instanceComment_BluechipSpoke: 0x973a023A77420ba610f06b3858aD991Df6d85A08 = the Aave V4 Bluechip Spoke on Ethereum, the venue of the WBTC Carry Fund (shares 0xf180800f239f0ea0ED2F8156581fac2984cEe389, portfolio Safe 0x0295E5d0530C23E560CdbFc097C488a0A0D7752D): WBTC collateral, USDC borrow, proceeds into the KPK USDC Yield + USDC Yield RWA Morpho vaults, both already carried by MorphoVaultsMeta. getReserveCount() == 12; the collateral-only reserves are 0 WETH / 1 WBTC / 2 cbBTC / 3 wstETH (all against the Prime Hub), so positionLabels renders ["Spoke", "WETH/WBTC/cbBTC/wstETH"] - the leaf is ONE joined segment. Read on-chain 2026-09-16 from getReserveConfig; NOT asserted by any test - the Aave V4 fork suite covers the Gold Spoke's leaf only, so this figure is an observation, not a guarded invariant. The fund's two legs are reserve 1 (WBTC, Prime Hub 0x943827DCA022D0F354a8a8c332dA1e5Eb9f9F931) and reserve 4 (USDC, Prime Hub) - the coordinate the strategy's own Aave UI link resolves to (1::0x973a...5A08::4). USDC is ALSO reserve 7 against the Core Hub 0xCca852Bc40e560adC3b1Cc58CA5b55638ce826c9, which is what lets one Spoke quote two borrow rates. Verified on-chain 2026-09-16.
AaveV4SpokesMeta.$instanceComment_MainSpoke: 0x94e7A5dCbE816e498b89aB752661904E2F56c485 = the Aave V4 Main Spoke on Ethereum, every reserve against the Core Hub 0xCca852Bc40e560adC3b1Cc58CA5b55638ce826c9. Carried for the same fund's second venue (WBTC reserve 3 as collateral, USDC reserve 7 as the borrow) so a market switch made for rate reasons needs no NAV transaction. getReserveCount() == 14; the collateral-only reserves are 1 wstETH / 2 weETH / 5 AAVE / 6 LINK, so positionLabels renders ["Spoke", "wstETH/weETH/AAVE/LINK"] - note WETH 0, WBTC 3 and cbBTC 4 ARE borrowable here, unlike on the Bluechip Spoke. Registering it now is cheap and forward-looking rather than immediately usable: at the time of writing the Core Hub's USDC drawCap for this Spoke is 15_000_000 whole USDC against 14_996_793 already drawn, so a tranche-sized borrow reverts DrawCapExceeded(15000000) until the DAO raises it. Verified on-chain 2026-09-16.
AaveV4SpokesMeta.$reserveRegistrationComment:
RESOLVED FOR THE THREE SPOKES CARRIED HERE, and kept because the reasoning still governs any FOURTH Spoke added later. The adapter's rule is asymmetric, and it gates on the ACCOUNT's own position first (`_instancePositions`: the `hasDebt || hasSupply` skip precedes the registry lookup), so an unregistered reserve the account never touches costs nothing. An unregistered SUPPLY it does touch is skipped (understates, safe). An unregistered BORROW drops the WHOLE Spoke - every leg, collateral included - rather than reporting supplies as unencumbered credit.

WHAT CHANGED 2026-09-16: USDG (0xe343167631d89B6Ffc58B88d6b7fB0228795491D), frxUSD (0xCAcd6fd266aF91b8AeD52aCCc382b4e165586E29) and LINK (0x514910771AF9Ca656af840dff83E8264EcF986CA) were registered as NAV assets with Chainlink primaries, so EVERY underlying on the Gold, Bluechip and Main Spokes is now a registered NAV asset and the whole-Spoke drop is UNREACHABLE on them - not merely unlikely. The borrowables that used to reach it were Gold 3 USDG / 4 frxUSD, Bluechip 11 USDG / 8 frxUSD and Main 11 USDG / 12 frxUSD; LINK was only ever Main reserve 6, which is collateral-only and so could never trigger it.

STILL OPEN, but much narrower than when this comment was first written: LBTC and syrupUSDG were REGISTERED later in this same PR (see assets-and-price-feeds/1.json), so the only underlyings still unpriced across the chain-1 Spokes are the three Pendle PTs - PT-USDe-7MAY2026 and PT-sUSDE-7MAY2026 (EthenaCorrelated, EthenaEcosystem) and PT-USDG-24SEP2026 (UsdgPendle). All three are COLLATERAL-ONLY, so they cannot trigger the whole-Spoke drop; a position in them is skipped, which understates. Every BORROWABLE underlying on every readable chain-1 Spoke is now a registered NAV asset. Note also the count: bgd-labs/aave-address-book lists FOURTEEN chain-1 Spokes, not 12, of which 13 are readable - TREASURY_SPOKE reverts getReserveCount() and must not be added. Before adding any further Spoke, enumerate its reserves (getReserveCount/getReserve) and check each borrowable underlying against nav-config/assets-and-price-feeds/1.json. Reserve layout verified on-chain 2026-09-16.

MorphoVaultsMeta.$comment: Meta-adapter (ADR 0010): one immutable adapter serving every Morpho ERC4626 vault. The active vault set lives on NAVCalculator and is applied via addMetaInstances/removeMetaInstances in 06_Configure (from `instances` below). This SUPERSEDES the per-vault MorphoVault_* adapters, which are disabled below — the NAV calculator now learns the Morpho-vault universe from this list.
MorphoVaultsMeta.$instanceComment_wARSYield: 0xb5ce3CA2C774b72955C25875022FdD91f7a7B938 = 'KPK wARS Yield' (Morpho Vaults V2; MORPHO() reverts, but the adapter is pure ERC-4626 and never calls it, and previewRedeem answers). asset() = wARS 0x0DC4F92879B7670e5f4e4e6e3c801D229129D90D, totalAssets ~5.0e27 (~5.0e9 wARS ~ $3.2M at $0.00063). Verified on-chain 2026-08-15. Unlike the Symbiotic LiquidLane vault this one IS genuinely a Morpho vault, so registering it here is the correct identity, not the mis-stamping this PR argues against.

MorphoMarketsMeta.$comment: Meta-adapter (ADR 0010): one immutable adapter serving every Morpho Blue market. The active marketId set lives on NAVCalculator (addMetaInstances/removeMetaInstances, from instancesRaw below). Supersedes the per-market MorphoMarket_* adapters, which are disabled below.

GearboxV3MarketsMeta.$comment: Meta-adapter (ADR 0010): one immutable adapter serving every Gearbox V3 ERC4626 farming pool. Emits one Supply leg per market (convertToAssets(balanceOf)) in the pool's underlying. The active market set lives on NAVCalculator (addMetaInstances/removeMetaInstances, from instances below — each entry is the market/pool address). Identity derived on-chain: positionId = market address; name = market name(). Supersedes the per-market GearboxMarket_* adapters, disabled below.

BalancerV3PoolsMeta.$comment: Meta-adapter (ADR 0010): one immutable adapter serving every Balancer V3 pool's wallet-held (unstaked) AMM liquidity only. The active pool set lives on NAVCalculator (addMetaInstances/removeMetaInstances, from instances below — each entry is the pool/BPT address). Gauge-staked LP + rewards are the separate BalancerV3GaugesMeta adapter. positionId derived on-chain = the pool address; name = BPT token name(). Supersedes the per-pool BalancerV3_* adapters, disabled below.

BalancerV3GaugesMeta.$comment: Meta-adapter (ADR 0010): one immutable adapter serving every Balancer V3 gauge's staked LP + BAL/extra rewards. The active gauge set lives on NAVCalculator (addMetaInstances/removeMetaInstances, from instances below — each entry is the gauge address). Wallet-held (unstaked) LP is the separate BalancerV3PoolsMeta adapter. positionId derived on-chain = the gauge address; name = the gauge's lp_token() BPT name(). Supersedes the per-pool BalancerV3_* adapters, disabled below.

BalancerV2PoolsMeta.$comment: Meta-adapter (ADR 0010): one immutable adapter serving every Balancer V2 pool's wallet-held BPT, decomposed pro-rata into the underlying tokens (composable-stable BPT-in-pool token excluded; supply via getActualSupply() when present else totalSupply()). The instance coordinate is the raw 32-byte poolId (instancesRaw below), NOT an address — the BPT address is derived on-chain as address(uint160(uint256(poolId) >> 96)). positionId derived on-chain = the BPT address; name = the BPT name(). Gauge-staked BPT is the separate BalancerV2GaugesMeta adapter. Disabled: no fund holds Balancer V2 positions today — the example instance is B-80BAL-20WETH, enable + add poolIds via addMetaInstances/removeMetaInstancesRaw when a position is opened.

BalancerV2GaugesMeta.$comment: Meta-adapter (ADR 0010): one immutable adapter serving every Balancer V2 gauge's staked BPT (decomposed pro-rata like BalancerV2PoolsMeta) + claimable BAL and extra reward tokens. The instance coordinate is the gauge address (instances below); the BPT is read on-chain via gauge.lp_token() and its poolId via getPoolId(). positionId derived on-chain = the gauge address; name = the gauge's lp_token() BPT name(). Wallet-held (unstaked) BPT is the separate BalancerV2PoolsMeta adapter. Disabled: no fund holds Balancer V2 gauge positions today — the example instance is the B-stETH-STABLE gauge, enable + add gauges via addMetaInstances/removeMetaInstances when a position is opened.

CurvePoolsMeta.$comment: Meta-adapter (ADR 0010): one immutable adapter serving wallet-held LP for every configured Curve pool. Instance coordinate = pool address. Supersedes wallet-LP reporting in per-instance Curve_* adapters, disabled below.

CurveGaugesMeta.$comment: Meta-adapter (ADR 0010): one immutable adapter serving gauge-staked LP + CRV + extra rewards for every configured Curve gauge. Instance coordinate = gauge address. Supersedes staked-LP + reward reporting in per-instance Curve_* adapters, disabled below.

ConvexCurveLPStakingMeta.$comment: Meta-adapter (ADR 0010): one immutable adapter serving every Convex pool. Instance coordinate = rewarder (BaseRewardPool) address. LP token resolved on-chain via rewarder.pid() → Booster.poolInfo(pid).lptoken. Emits Supplied legs (staked LP decomposed into Curve pool tokens) + Earned legs (CRV exact, CVX via cliff schedule, extra rewards). Supersedes per-instance Convex_* adapters, disabled below.

FluidFTokensMeta.$comment: Meta-adapter (ADR 0010): one immutable adapter serving every Fluid fToken (ERC4626 lending vault). One Supply leg per fToken (convertToAssets(balanceOf)) in its underlying. The active fToken set lives on NAVCalculator (addMetaInstances/removeMetaInstances, from instances below — each entry is an fToken address). Identity derived on-chain: positionId = fToken address; name = fToken symbol(). Supersedes the per-fToken Fluid_fToken_* adapters, disabled below.

FluidVaultsMeta.$comment: Meta-adapter (ADR 0010): one immutable adapter serving every Fluid T1 vault. Emits a Collateral leg (supply) and a Borrow leg (debt) per vault, aggregated over the account's NFT positions. The VaultResolver is the chain-level constant pinned in the constructor; the active vault set lives on NAVCalculator (addMetaInstances/removeMetaInstances, from instances below — each entry is a T1 vault address). Identity derived on-chain: positionId = vault address; name = collSym/debtSym. Supersedes the per-vault Fluid_Vault_* adapters, disabled below. T1 vaults only.

CompoundV3CometsMeta.$comment: Meta-adapter (ADR 0010): one immutable adapter serving every Compound V3 (Comet) market. Emits base Supply/Borrow + per-collateral Collateral + COMP Rewards legs per comet. CometRewards + reward token (COMP) are chain-level constants pinned in the constructor; the active comet set lives on NAVCalculator (addMetaInstances/removeMetaInstances, from instances below — each entry is a comet address). Identity derived on-chain: positionId = comet address; name = comet name(). Supersedes the per-comet CompoundV3_* adapters, disabled below. cinUSDC (Compound Institutional Market, base USDC) was seeded on the LIVE mainnet NAV by a direct addMetaInstances governance tx on 2026-08-24 (0x67eab0f01ec3cd5c4d68d4b30ebcf9b28cb533478a7088642b6b3238a2a2491a, block 25826568), which left this committed list at 6 while the chain held 7. Added here so a redeploy does not DROP it: 06_Configure seeds the instance set from this file, so an instance that exists only on-chain is silently lost the next time the set is rebuilt, and the positions it reports vanish from NAV. See issue #312.

StakeWiseV3VaultsMeta.$comment: Meta-adapter (ADR 0010): one immutable adapter serving every StakeWise V3 vault. Emits a Staking leg (vault shares) and a Borrow leg (osToken debt) per vault, both denominated in the underlying staking asset. The active vault set lives on NAVCalculator (addMetaInstances/removeMetaInstances, from instances below). underlyingToken is the chain-level constant (ETH sentinel on mainnet). Identity derived on-chain: positionId = vault address; name = vault name(). Supersedes the per-vault StakeWiseV3Vault_* adapters, disabled below.

EulerVaultsMeta.$comment: Euler V2 vaults held by KPK DAO/Foundation: KPK_ETH_Term (WETH) + kpk_RWA_USDC (USDC) — both EulerEarn (Earn) aggregator vaults today, supply-only. Both underlyings already registered. The adapter also handles core eVaults (Lend/Borrow): add future Euler vaults here.

UniswapV3PoolsMeta.$comment: Meta-adapter (ADR 0010): one immutable adapter serving every configured Uniswap V3 pool. The NPM is ERC721Enumerable, so per-account NFT positions are discovered fully on-chain (balanceOf/tokenOfOwnerByIndex/positions) — no agent-fed cache (this reverts the interim assisted UniswapV3PoolsAssisted). The active pool set lives on NAVCalculator (addMetaInstances/removeMetaInstances, from instances below — each entry is a pool address). Both pool tokens must be registered (else the pool is dropped), so only pools whose pair is fully priced are listed: USDC/WETH 0.05% (0x88e6A0c2), WBTC/WETH 0.3% (0xCBCdF962), WETH/USDT 0.3% (0x4e68Ccd3), USDC/RWIV 0.05% (0x764D5075 — RWIV priced via its ERC4626 feed; LP held by the Nexus Safe, previously covered by the open-universe assisted adapter). COW/sETH2 pools are intentionally omitted (COW is unpriced and not registered, sETH2 untracked). Unlike the open-universe assisted adapter, this list must enumerate every pool a tracked account LPs in — keep it in sync with live holdings. positionId = pool; NFT id in positionInstanceId; legs Supplied (in-range liquidity) + Fees (unclaimed).

SymbioticVaultsMeta.$comment: Meta-adapter (ADR 0010): one immutable adapter serving Symbiotic ERC-4626 vaults. Scope is ERC-4626 vaults ONLY, not Symbiotic CORE vaults - measured 2026-08-15 on KPK USDC LiquidLane, whose 4626 surface answers while collateral()/epochDuration()/currentEpoch()/activeShares()/burner() all revert. Redemption is synchronous (maxRedeem == balanceOf for every real holder sampled), so a single Supplied leg is complete. Kept separate from MorphoVaultsMeta - which would value these vaults correctly - so the position is not stamped with morpho identity.

PolygonStakingMeta.$comment: Active Polygon PoS ValidatorShare set. SELECTION: all 209 live ValidatorShares were enumerated via StakeManager.getValidatorContract(1..209) and probed for every fixture account (2026-08-26); exactly one delegation exists - validator 192, share 0x97997023aab1d6b9760538eb621bf10cfcd84868 ('Delegated POL #c0', dPOLc0), held by 0x0EFcCBb9E2C09Ea29551879bd9Da32362b32fc89 at 106,114.233772 POL plus ~734 POL rewards. The other 208 are deliberately omitted: _instancePositions costs one external call PER CONFIGURED INSTANCE per account per NAV read, so registering all 209 would buy 208 empty results on every read. Adding one is an addMetaInstances TX, not a deploy. All 209 share a single implementation (0xbe63b977...e9e8) and answer getStakeAndRewards, so any of them can be added without a code change.
